value.signature: fn computed_proposal_matches_supplied_commitment (body : & ProposalBody , recorded_proposal : & ProposalCommitment , content_pair : & ContentPair , author_dependency_blinding_value : & SecretSlice < u8 > , dependencies : & SecretBox < DependencyIds > ,) -> Result < () , ProfileError >

review.body: { if recorded_proposal . recipe != PROPOSAL_RECIPE { return Err (ProfileError :: Recipe) ; } let computed = computed_proposal_commitment (body , content_pair , author_dependency_blinding_value , dependencies) ? ; if computed . as_recorded () != recorded_proposal { return Err (ProfileError :: Proposal) ; } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The full private openings remain protected; the public P comparison is a verdict, not authority or custody evidence.
